description: This file defines functions and types for resolving and managing Microsoft Teams proactive messaging contexts, including parsing recipient identifiers, finding conversation references, and constructing the context object for sending messages.

methods.name: parseRecipient
methods.description: Parses a recipient string into a type ('conversation' or 'user') and an ID, supporting various formats.

methods.name: findConversationReference
methods.description: Finds a stored conversation reference for a given recipient, either by direct ID or preferred DM.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsSendContext
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the context object needed for proactive messaging in Microsoft Teams, including conversation reference, SDK, adapter, token provider, and configuration details.
